spec.text: Image 1 is the man's character model sheet; image 2 is the approved art style (sculpted matte clay figurines placed in a painted storybook set). A faded, slightly overexposed old snapshot from his university days, with a plain white instant-photo border that has no writing anywhere: the man from the model sheet about ten years younger, around twenty, grinning on a dirt forest trail, wearing a plain white short-sleeve cycling jersey with no logos, black baggy mountain-bike shorts and knee pads, holding a full-suspension downhill mountain bike, a full-face helmet tucked under his arm, still wearing his black rectangular glasses. Every character is a dimensional sculpted matte clay figurine exactly like the people in the art-style image, about four heads tall, adult, never a flat 2D drawing; mouths closed in small gentle smiles. Recreate any real place from the photos in the same warm matte clay and gouache storybook style. Cinematic composition. Any signs, plaques, screens or documents are blank; no readable text and no logos. No other people. No photorealism, no glossy plastic.
